etsy.title: Hockey Bag Sticker, Funny Caution Warning Sign, Smelly Gear Joke Decal, Sports Mom Gift, Player Gift
etsy.description:
A hockey bag sticker in the style of a yellow caution sign: open only in a ventilated area, and do not make eye contact with the gloves.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, notebook, garage cabinet, or a gear room door. It is indoor vinyl, so it is not meant for the bag itself. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
etsy.category: Paper & Party Supplies > Paper > Stickers, Labels & Tags > Stickers

competitorNotes: Single hockey stickers appear at about $3 to $6, and many competitors advertise waterproof vinyl for bottles and cars, which this indoor sticker cannot match.
Hockey mom designs were the most common sticker results seen.

research.notes: Smelly bag jokes sell on other products, such as a "smell my hockey bag" shirt and a candle, but no caution-sign sticker appeared. "hockey bag sticker" itself was not seen as an indexed phrase, so it is a best guess for the primary keyword. Amazon was not searched. Evidence is from search results only, with no sales data.
